player_prompt.intro:
Galmaan {N} ol taate hidden values ykn dhaban.
Kaleessa kuni type [accept] pick the *current* value, ykn [continue] skip itiin isa dhabne.
Yoo ta'u hin fudhatin, galmaan akkam dhabne value guddaa fudhachuu isaa.
Yoo value fudhate ni guddaa keessaa ta'e (reward = 1) **akka** ta'u.

outcome.summary: Galmaa {value} draw {draw_num}/{N} keessatti fudhate. Innis ni kessaa guddaa {best} ture. {result}
